views: view1: TRUSS NO:001, 005 — DIAGRAMATIC ONLY - NOT TO SCALE (this split: section)
warnings: ALTERNATIVE roof system: A-05 lets the contractor choose either the hot-rolled steel roof (S-06, S-22, S-23) or this cold-formed prefab truss system (โครงหลังคาสำเร็จรูป, PT-01..PT-05). Both are recorded; a BOQ must use one of them, not both.
The sheet prints only truss outlines and numbers ("DIAGRAMATIC ONLY - NOT TO SCALE") — no dimensions, no sections; recorded so the truss numbers on PT-02 resolve to a drawn shape.
